newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss Life sees higher premium, result.
newsitem.headline: Swiss Life sees higher premium, result.

text.p: Swiss Life said it expected its premium income this year to rise by around 10 percent and its result should also be higher.
"The 1996 result should slightly surpass the previous year's level based on today's view," chief financial officer Andreas Donatsch said.
Donatsch was speaking at a Swiss Life presentation to investors.
He noted that Swiss Life's investment policy had been successful this year, especially in the equity market and in foreign currencies.
The lower level of interest rates, however, had a negative effect on financial results.
